texts: Keepers count the visible sky-cats on the cliff-spires each morning.
Keepers track the weight of the feather harvest.

fields.sentence: Keepers count the visible sky-cats on the cliff-spires each morning.
parse: (: keeper_count_rule (Implication (Member $x keeper) (And (Member (sk_count $x) count) (Agent (sk_count $x) $x) (Theme (sk_count $x) sk_group_1) (Time (sk_count $x) morning) (Every (sk_count $x) 1 day))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: The descriptive modifier "visible" correctly distributes over the definite group by a PartOf rule instead of riding the group symbol, "each morning" gets the named slot plus its implied cycle (Time morning + Every 1 day) with no QuantifierPhrase (matching the habitual-schedule examples), and "on the cliff-spires" keeps the entity-attached surface preposition. The PP was attached to the sky-cats rather than to the counting event; that is the favored reading, so single-reading output is right.

fields.sentence: Keepers track the weight of the feather harvest.

review.notes: Bare-generic distributing rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase, Theme for the unchanged object of "track", and the feather_harvest genus (noun modifier not exposed) are all correct. "the weight of X" fails the nominalization verb-paraphrase test ("weigh" does not take the harvest as object) and is not a part, so the opaque Possession is the licensed genitive route.
